record.name: Force Nexus
record.narrative: You channel force energy through your power, unleashing destructive force that rip through their defenses with telekinetic power. The power manifests as invisible pressure, kinetic impact, creating a moment of controlled power.
record.flavor_text: Size matters not. Look at me.

manifestation.description: clear, forceful gesture extending telekinetic energy
visualizing the desired effect and channeling Force energy

base_effect.description: You create a focal point of pure Force energy that draws all power toward it, creating a devastating vortex of destruction and creation.

mechanics.notes: Dexterity save or take 10d10 force damage
Failed save pulls target 30 feet toward nexus center
All Force powers cast within range deal +2d10 damage

class_synergies.narrative: Guardian approaches Force Nexus through the lens of protection, finding unexpected harmony in the manipulating the Force to achieve the impossible. Their defensive combat and protection of others guides them to vibrating air with a focused resolve that reflects their unique perspective.

mechanical_benefit.notes: Guardians gain +3 to Force power attack rolls.

species_synergies.narrative: Human adaptability allows them to quickly master new powers.

mechanical_benefit.notes: Humans gain advantage on power learning checks.

faction_synergies.narrative: The Jedi Order teaches the proper use of Force powers.

mechanical_benefit.notes: Jedi gain +2 to Force power saving throw DCs.

llm_guidance.roleplay_guidance: Describe the force damage affecting the target, the force_attraction effect taking hold, the force damage affecting the target. Focus on how the power's effects manifest physically and mechanically, emphasizing deal force damage.
llm_guidance.tactical_notes: Force Nexus is excellent for dealing force damage to multiple enemies in an area. Use it at 300 feet range. The effects last Concentration, up to 10 minute.
narrative_hooks: A combatant uses Force Nexus to devastating effect, the force damage overwhelming their foe
The raw power of Force Nexus is unleashed, force energy coursing through the battlefield

image_generation.base_prompt: A dramatic digital painting of. Force Nexus. in action. unleashing devastating force damage. with invisible pressure, kinetic impact. The mood is controlled power, showing the raw power and intensity of the effect.
